Specification: This module is a small model-checking wrapper around an existing specification imported from Session11b, with an instance of Session11a used to refer to another specification property. It introduces a concrete finite message set ConstData, a state constraint bounding the lengths of the AtoB and BtoA channels, and several state predicates characterizing type correctness and simple invariants over the communication state. The module does not define its own transition relation or temporal specification, but instead defines predicates such as AB_TypeOK, AB_Inv, and AB_TwoValsSeq, and exposes ABSpecProperty as the Spec operator from the instantiated Session11a module.
